changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Add Virology roles to AllLabUnits for admin access
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO lab_unit_role (id, lab_unit_id, system_role_id, active, created_date, lastupdated) SELECT NEXTVAL('lab_unit_role_seq'), (SELECT id FROM lab_unit WHERE name = 'AllLabUnits'), sr.id, true, now(), now() FROM system_role sr WHERE sr.name IN ( 'Virology Lab Technician', 'Virology Microbiologist', 'Virology Manager', 'Virology Principal Investigator', 'Virology Data Manager' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lab_unit_role lur JOIN lab_unit lu ON lur.lab_unit_id = lu.id WHERE lu.name = 'AllLabUnits' AND lur.system_role_id = sr.id );
